articles.headline: Steve Clarke quits as Scotland boss after elimination from 2026 World Cup
articles.description: Steve Clarke has stepped down as manager of Scotland men's team after their elimination from the 2026 World Cup at the group stages was confirmed on Saturday.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily LIVE: Colombia-Portugal kick off, England win Group L
articles.description: It's the final day of World Cup action from the group stages, as Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo and Argentina's Lionel Messi (maybe) could play on the same day.

articles.headline: Bellingham, Kane star for England in 2-0 win
articles.description: Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane net a pair of goals within the space of five minutes as England top Group L following a 2-0 victory against Panama.

articles.headline: Still uninspiring, but England avoid nightmare World Cup knockout scenario
articles.description: England earned a 2-0 win over Panama and topped Group L, but only after an almost painful first-half bereft of clear-cut chances.

articles.headline: 2026 World Cup: How teams can advance to the knockout rounds
articles.description: Who can secure qualification before the group stage ends, and whose World Cup dreams could be shattered? Here's what you need to know.
